name: Time Tunnel
source:
In Time Tunnel story picks up where Time Secret Ended. Your time machine collapsed and your are taken prisoner at space station. You need to use this planet Time Tunnel technology to go back in 2552 AD and fight off Danak invasion.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《时空隧道》的故事承接《时空秘闻》结局。你的时间机损坏，自己也被囚禁在一座太空站中。你必须利用这颗星球的“时空隧道”技术回到2552年，击退达纳克人的入侵。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
